system.description:
You call a brief phantom out of dreamstuff — a rose blooming in your palm, a low moan of wind, the rasp of sandpaper — a single false sensation with no more substance than a thought.

Expend one Willpower Trait and best your subjects in a Social Challenge (retest Subterfuge). The illusion affects a single sense and cannot move on its own, though you may hold and brandish an illusion you create (an illusory knife you carry). It has no substance and cannot confine or injure. It persists until you leave the area, until you dispel it (immediate, no action), or until someone disbelieves it by testing it — passing a hand through the rose, feeling for a wind that is not there.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
